# Real-board regression decks

Origin: `/Users/leminh/Documents/circuit/simulation/harness/out/decks/*.cir`
(ngspice-style decks generated by `board_to_spice.mjs` from routed tscircuit boards:
arc lighter, FM radio lab rx/tx, radio lab rx/tx, tricolor lamp, uNode32U4).
The source tree is read-only; these are *effective* copies, edited only where the
harness deck is not something ngspice can run (the harness never ran ngspice: it ran its
own `spice.mjs`, whose switches/gap/noise/PWM were driven from JavaScript between steps).

## What was changed from the harness decks (and why)

| deck | change |
|---|---|
| all with `.tran`/`.ac` | none; `.end` kept. First line of each deck is a comment (SPICE title). |
| tricolor-lamp | the `.model D1N5819 ...` card had no newline before the controller header comment (harness bug) - split. `RJ1G 0 0` (a resistor with both ends on ground) removed. `SWALL` (closed from the op point) -> `RSWALL 0.05`. `SU2AWAKE`/`RU2A` (never closed in the harness run) removed. The firmware PWM that the harness toggled via `c.get("EPB4").g` becomes `BPB4 u2_pb4 0 V=V(vcc)*V(pwm)` + `VPWM pwm 0 PULSE(0 1 0 1n 1n 350u 1m)` (35 % of 1 ms). `SQn node 0 RON= ROFF=` (state set in `onStep` when gate > 2.5 V) -> `SQn node 0 gate 0 SWMOS` with `.model SWMOS SW(RON=0.025 ROFF=1e8 VT=2.5 VH=0)`. |
| arc-lighter | `SQ1 varm vdrv RON= ROFF=` (open for the op point, closed at t = 0) -> `SQ1 ... ctlq1 0 SWQ1` + `VCTLQ1 ctlq1 0 PULSE(0 1 0 1n 1n 10 20)`. `YGAP` (harness spark-gap device) -> two hysteretic `S` branches (one per polarity) with a 1 V arc source in series: strikes at 17.5 V, holds until I < 0.8 A. `K1 LP LF LS 0.97` -> three pairwise `K` cards (ngspice K takes 2 inductors). |
| fm-radio-lab-rx | `INOISE 0 tank 0` (seeded 100 nA band-limited noise set by `setFn`) -> deterministic `IKICK 0 tank PULSE(0 5u 0 0.2n 0.2n 1n 1)`. |
| radio-lab-rx | `VANT1 ... 0` (driven by `setFn` at the AC-aligned tank frequency) -> `BANT` 30 mV, 30 % AM, 1 kHz tone at 818987.342 Hz (peak of `radio-lab-rx.tank-alignment`, an extra AC deck = the harness's alignment sweep: `.ac lin 80 500k 1.1meg`). |
| unode-32u4.usb-hotplug | `PULSE(0 5 2u 0.1u)` -> `PULSE(0 5 2u 0.1u 1n 1 2)` (explicit TF/PW/PER: the harness defaults differ from ngspice's TSTEP/TSTOP). |
| unode-32u4.crystal-ring | `INU1_SEED 0 xtal1 0` (pluck set by `setFn`) -> `BSEED 0 xtal1 I='u(time-10u)*u(50u-time)*50u*sin(2*pi*fs*time)'`. |
| the rest | verbatim. |

## Acceptance metrics (from the harness testbenches' physics checks)

Defined once in `tests/helpers/real-boards-specs.ts` and applied identically to ngspice
output and to our engine's output. Reference values from real ngspice 47 live in
`refs.json` (regenerate: `UPDATE_REFS=1 npx vitest run tests/real-boards.test.ts`).

| deck | analysis | metrics (harness check it implements) |
|---|---|---|
| unode-32u4.indicators | .op | V5, the four LED currents (2.96 / 2.89 / 2.89 / 2.89 mA) |
| unode-32u4.usb-hotplug | .tran | inrush peak (5.7 A), V5 final (4.91 V), tau (R*C theory 5.4 us) |
| unode-32u4.avcc-isolation | .ac | bead/cap attenuation at 0.5, 1, 2, 10, 100 MHz |
| unode-32u4.crystal-resonance | .ac | dip frequency, contrast, Q of the series-resonance dip |
| unode-32u4.crystal-ring | .tran | ring frequency, pluck amplitude, ring-down amplitude (tau/Q) |
| tricolor-lamp.pwm-channel | .tran | LED string peak/average current, off current, 12 V rail minimum |
| radio-lab-tx.am-modulation | .tran | carrier frequency, AM depth, RF amplitude |
| radio-lab-rx.tank-alignment | .ac | tank peak frequency (819 kHz), tank gain |
| radio-lab-rx.receiving | .tran | tank / detector / LM386-output amplitudes |
| fm-radio-lab-tx.fm-deviation | .tran | carrier frequency (90 MHz class), tank swing |
| fm-radio-lab-rx.super-regen | .tran | quench period, RF burst frequency and peak |
| arc-lighter.firing | .tran | see the note in `tests/real-boards.test.ts` |
